rules.entry: First 5-minute bar is 09:30-09:35. Fill is the 09:35 open.
rules.flat: 15:55 bar close, or the last bar of a short session.

cells.plain: Go long when the open is above the prior day's low in an uptrend, and short when the open is below it in a downtrend. Trend means the daily 20 EMA is sloping that way and price is on that side of it. The first 5-minute candle has to close in that direction and beyond the level. Buy or sell the 09:35 open. Stop is the level that was crossed. Target is 1R. Flat by the 15:55 close. At most 3 new entries a day.
